original_question: Stephen tụrụ ahịa maka ịhe oriri n'ịntaneti. Ego nille ọ ga-akwụ pụtara $40.00. Maka na ịhe na-abịa site n'aka onye na-ewelata ahịa, ha tinyere 25% n'ego ikpeazụ ọ ga-akwụ ma naa ya $3.00 n'ego ịweta ahịa. Stephen tinyekwara onyinye afọ ofufo $4.00. Ka ego mgbakwunye ahụ gasịrị, gịnị bụ ego ole Stephen jiri zụọ ihe oriri?
